stations.title: Dilys
stations.say: Can this be a real page?

stations.title: Her text file
stations.text: The words are there, with no HTML at all.

captions: Dilys runs Kilnworth Pottery and wants the studio's first web page.
She typed her words into a file, but the browser shows them as one long line.
You write the page's skeleton, its head and its body, in three tasks.
The tab shows the studio's name and the words sit on their own lines.
Same words as before. Now the file is a real page.
